landing.heroBadge: Built for EE, EPQ, and school-led research
landing.subheadline: Roto helps students plan, develop, and complete research projects for programmes such as the IB Extended Essay and A-Level EPQ, with guided support from AI mentors and school teachers.
landing.programmesTitle: Built around the research work international schools already assign
landing.programmesSubtitle: Roto supports structured academic projects without forcing every student into the same topic, method, or timeline.
landing.programmeEeDesc: Guide students from initial interest to research question, source strategy, writing plan, reflection, and final submission.
landing.programmeEpqDesc: Support independent project planning, evidence gathering, production logs, supervisor feedback, and assessment preparation.
landing.programmeIndependentDesc: Run school-based research programmes, college portfolio projects, summer research, or exploratory academic inquiry.
landing.journeyTitle: From a vague interest to a finished research project
landing.journeySubtitle: Roto gives students a clear path while preserving their own thinking. The platform helps them make progress, document choices, and understand why each step matters.
landing.journeyQuestion: Shape a focused research question from real interests
landing.journeyPlan: Build a timeline with realistic weekly tasks
landing.journeySources: Find and organize credible sources and evidence
landing.journeyDraft: Develop arguments, analysis, and project outputs
landing.journeySubmit: Prepare final work for school review
landing.schoolTitle: A supervision layer for teachers and research coordinators
landing.schoolSubtitle: The school version separates student exploration from teacher oversight. Teachers can create cohorts, monitor research activity, review phase submissions, and align feedback with school-defined standards.
landing.schoolFeatureProgress: View student timelines and research actions
landing.schoolFeatureApprovals: Require teacher approval at each phase
landing.schoolIntro1: For students, Roto provides structure without taking away ownership of the research.
landing.schoolIntro2: For teachers, Roto keeps the research process visible enough to support timely feedback.
landing.schoolIntro3: For schools, Roto helps standardize supervision across EE, EPQ, and school-led research programmes.
landing.partnersSubtitle: Roto is currently working with multiple international schools to support structured student research, teacher supervision, and school-based research programmes.
landing.partnersNote: School names and case studies can be shared with permission as pilots and collaborations progress.
landing.ctaTitle: Bring guided research support to your school
landing.ctaSubtitle: Roto helps students move from uncertainty to a complete research project, while giving teachers the visibility and control needed for school programmes.
landing.footerTag: Roto - AI Research Mentor for International Schools

login.subtitle: From topic selection to execution — Roto guides you through every stage, one clear step at a time.
login.bullet2: Big goals broken into small steps
login.bullet3: Steady support when things get hard
login.rotaSaysQuote: "Don't judge yourself yet. Let's look at the actual problem first."

welcome.intro: I'm Roto — your research mentor. No need to have everything figured out. Just tell me where you are, and we'll find the right starting point together.
welcome.rotaQuote: "Do you already have a topic, or are you still looking for one? Either way, we'll work it out."
welcome.noTopicDesc: Roto will learn about your interests, skills, and time — then help you find a research direction that actually fits.
welcome.hasTopicDesc: Share your topic with Roto and we'll turn it into a clear, executable research plan.
welcome.projectsSubtitle: Continue an existing project or start a new one from here.
welcome.projectsEmpty: No projects yet. Start with a topic and Roto will help you build the plan.

topicChat.title: Chat with your AI mentor
topicChat.subtitle: Your mentor will learn about your interests, skills, and schedule through conversation to help find the right research topic
topicChat.defaultHint: If you just want to experience the full flow, you can continue with the default profile. You can always add more information later.
topicChat.keepChattingHint: Keep chatting a little more. The profile button will appear once Roto has enough information.
topicChat.readyHint: Looks like Roto has enough context. Generate your profile to review it in the next step.
topicChat.tutorStatus: Learning about your interests and skills

topicChat.placeholder: Tell your mentor about things you're interested in...
topicChat.initialMessage: Hi! I'm Roto, your research mentor. Before we find your topic, I'd love to learn a bit about you first — what are you interested in, or curious about?

topicProfile.title: Your profile report
topicProfile.subtitle: This report was generated by your AI mentor based on your conversation. Please confirm if it's accurate.
topicProfile.defaultNotice: This is a default profile draft to help you quickly experience the topic selection flow. If anything is off, you can add more information before continuing.
topicProfile.generating: Your AI mentor is generating your profile report...
topicProfile.impactInterests: Roto will prioritize research directions and reference cases connected to these interests, so the next topic suggestions feel personally relevant.
topicProfile.impactSkills: Roto will match topic difficulty and methods to what you can realistically handle, while leaving room to learn one or two new skills.
topicProfile.impactTime: Roto will control project scope, timeline, and weekly task load so the plan fits your available time.
topicProfile.impactPreference: Roto will shape the recommended outputs and research style around how you prefer to investigate questions.
topicProfile.nextRecommendationTitle: How Roto will use this profile next
topicProfile.recommendStep1Desc: Your interests decide which research areas appear first.
topicProfile.recommendStep2Desc: Your skills and time limit the difficulty and workload.
topicProfile.recommendStep3Desc: Your preferences shape the final topic names, outputs, and plan.
topicProfile.supplementDesc: You can upload PDF files and add written notes to help your mentor understand you better

Has foundational skills in information search and data organization, with a natural ability to observe everyday phenomena and ask questions. A great fit to start their research journey with social investigation or experimental observation projects.
